description: This Java class defines a Spring Boot REST controller named CarController, which exposes API endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting Car entities. It interacts with a service layer (CarService) to perform CRUD operations and uses annotations for request mappings and dependency injection.

classes.name: CarController
classes.description: A REST controller managing CRUD operations for Car entities via HTTP endpoints.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a new Car object in the system.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve all Car entries as a list of maps.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a Car by its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update an existing Car identified by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to remove a Car by ID.
